idea-plugin.name: Project Taskbar Badge
idea-plugin.description:
Displays each open project's icon as a Windows taskbar overlay badge on its IDE window button, making it easy to distinguish multiple open projects at a glance.

Features:
  • Uses the project's custom icon (.idea/icon_dark.png, .idea/icon.png, or .idea/icon.svg).
  • Optional fallback to the generated project letter badge in the project's header color when no custom icon is configured.
  • Configurable badge size (16-32 px) and toggles in Settings | Tools | Project Taskbar Badge with instant apply.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.3
  • Fixed fallback project letter badge not appearing when no custom icon is set: DeferredIcon is now painted against the frame's showing JRootPane and polled on the EDT until evaluated.
  • Cached rendered badges per project and reapplied them on window activation, focus gain, and state changes so Windows taskbar overlays do not disappear over time.
1.1.2
  • Fixed a black square badge caused by rendering an unevaluated DeferredIcon placeholder on startup or size change; deferred icons are now evaluated off the EDT before updating the taskbar overlay, and fully transparent images are skipped.
1.1.1
  • Removed usage of the internal IntelliJ Platform API (RecentProjectsManagerBase.hasCustomIcon) reported by the Plugin Verifier; custom project icons are now detected directly from .idea/icon*.png|svg.
  • Fixed a NoSuchMethodError on IntelliJ Platform 2025.1 and 2025.2: the project icon is now taken through getProjectIcon(String, …), which exists in all supported releases, instead of the Path overload that only appeared in 2025.3.
1.1.0
  • Added Settings UI under Tools | Project Taskbar Badge.
  • Added project-colored letter badge fallback for projects without a custom icon (can be toggled off).
  • Added configurable badge size (default 24x24 px) and instant refresh on settings or project color changes.
